3.7 Energy
Electricity generated and distributed went up to 4,744,345.8 KWh from 3,791,512.3 KWh recorded in
the year ending June 2015 (Table 3.7), owing to commencement of production by Kinyerezi I plant,
with installed capacity of 150 megawatts. Dar es Salaam zone accounted for 87.2 percent of the
electricity generated. On the other hand, gas production from Songo Songo and Mnazi Bay fields
rose by 60.9 percent from the volume recorded in the previous year, following completion of Mnazi
Bay pipe line project. Gas production is dominated by Songas, which accounted for about 63.6
percent of total natural gas produced in Eastern zone (Mtwara and Lindi).
